name: better-subchat
description: Ask about any part of a long Claude Code conversation in a side thread that never enters the main conversation.

contextMode.title: Context mode
contextMode.description: snapshot: a side thread reads the main conversation as it was when the thread opened, until you press Refresh; follow: every question reads it as it is now.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Model for new side threads: inherit (the main conversation's), an alias such as haiku, or a full model id.

defaultStrategy.title: Default strategy
defaultStrategy.description: fork: a subagent that shares the main context (main model only); agent: the plugin's own subagent on any model; light: one tool-less answer.

maxDepth.title: Maximum depth
maxDepth.description: How many nested side-thread levels may be open at once (at least 3).

autoModeSpawn.title: Allow side-thread subagents in auto mode
autoModeSpawn.description: In auto mode, let a side-thread question you send start its subagent; the subagent's own tool calls are still judged by auto mode. Off: auto mode answers without tools.

language.title: Pane language
language.description: The pane's language until you switch it with its language button: en (English) or zh (简体中文).

backflowEnabled.title: Backflow
backflowEnabled.description: Offer, under each answer, to send it along with your next main-conversation prompt, keep it as a note, or copy it. Off: nothing goes back.
